records.text: Nate won his first video game tournament during the week of January 14–20, 2022, playing on a team in Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, a team shooter game; Nate said he and his team had fun through the end of the tournament.
Joanna has been working on a project recently, but Joanna did not specify what the project is.
Joanna enjoys writing, reading, watching movies, and exploring nature; Joanna is not interested in video games.
Nate's main hobbies are playing video games and watching movies.
Nate especially likes action and science-fiction movies because Nate enjoys their effects.
Joanna and Nate both enjoy watching movies, so Joanna and Nate have at least one shared interest.
Joanna prefers dramas and romantic comedies because she enjoys becoming immersed in their emotions and plots.
Joanna especially likes a romantic drama about memory and relationships; she considers the movie one of her favorites and appreciates its concept and acting.
On January 21, 2022, Joanna recommended Nate a romantic drama about memory and relationships and shared a photo of its poster showing a man and a woman sitting on a bench.
Joanna first watched the recommended romantic drama around 2019 and later bought a physical DVD copy; Joanna shared a photo of the DVD on a table with a blurry background.
Joanna has watched the recommended romantic drama a few times.
Nate enjoys watching classic movies and said he planned to watch Joanna's recommended romantic drama soon.
Joanna recommended a romantic drama about memory and relationships to Nate, and Joanna asked Nate to tell her whether he liked it after watching it.
On January 21, 2022, Joanna finished and printed her first full screenplay after working on it for a while. A shared photo showed a book containing a page of screenplay text.
Joanna's first full screenplay is a mix of drama and romance.
On January 23, 2022, Joanna felt relief, excitement, and some anxiety after finishing her screenplay.
Joanna planned to submit her completed screenplay to film festivals in hopes that producers and directors would review it, leading to positive feedback and new opportunities.
Nate keeps two turtles as pets and has had them for three years as of January 23, 2022. A shared photo showed one turtle and one smaller turtleling sitting on a rock.

Nate says his two turtles bring him tons of joy, have big personalities despite being small, and help keep him calm when he is nervous or stressed. Nate recommends having pets like his turtles during stressful times.
Joanna is allergic to some animals and said she might get pets of her own soon if she can find animals she is not allergic to.

After Nate's Counter-Strike: Global Offensive tournament during January 14–20, 2022, Nate began spending time with some people outside his usual social circle whom he met at the tournament. Nate thinks these people are pretty cool, although they were competitors at the tournament.
On 2022-01-23, Nate said he tends to spend time with the more chill people at the competition because some participants are more competitive than others.
On 2022-01-23, Nate said he would cheer on competitors even if he lost, because he does not expect to win big and enjoys playing for fun.
Joanna experiences severe allergic reactions around certain animals: her face becomes puffy and itchy. Joanna has generally avoided animals because of these allergies.
Joanna is allergic to most reptiles and animals with fur, making it difficult for her to have pets.
Joanna finds joy in writing and spending time with friends. Writing lets Joanna express herself through stories and feelings, while friends provide enjoyable social time.

Joanna describes writing as essential to her life because it allows her to create wild worlds with awesome characters and express her feelings; Joanna intends to continue pursuing writing as her passion.
On 2022-01-23, Nate responded sympathetically to Joanna's severe allergies and encouraged her to continue writing and doing what she loves.

On 2022-02-07, Joanna said the screenplay she submitted to a film festival had been on her mind every day, and she was experiencing relief, excitement, and worry while hoping a producer or director would love it enough to bring it to the big screen.
On 2022-02-07, Nate encouraged Joanna about her film-festival screenplay and hoped a producer or director would bring it to the big screen.
On 2022-02-07, Joanna said she had put a lot of effort into her screenplay and appreciated Nate's support while hoping it would succeed.
On 2022-02-07, Nate made coconut milk ice cream for the first time, found it surprisingly good, and shared a photo of a bowl of ice cream with a spoon in it.
Nate described coconut milk ice cream as rich and creamy and said it might become his new favorite snack.
Nate planned to make coconut milk ice cream again and experiment with different flavors and toppings.
Nate likes coconut milk, chocolate, and mixed berry flavors in dairy-free desserts.
Before 2022-02-07, Nate made a dairy-free chocolate cake topped with berries and shared that creation in conversation with Joanna.
On 2022-02-07, Joanna praised Nate's cooking skills, said his dairy-free chocolate cake with berries sounded delicious, and considered either making one herself or visiting Nate to try one.
Nate enjoys experimenting in the kitchen and trying new recipes.
On 2022-02-07, Joanna asked Nate for movie recommendations after discussing his cooking creations; Nate said he had not watched any movies recently and asked Joanna to recommend one.
Joanna thought the film "Little Women" was amazing and described it as a great story about sisterhood, love, and reaching for one's dreams.
Joanna enjoys giving movie recommendations and considers "Little Women" a must-see.
Nate planned to add "Little Women" to his movie watchlist after Joanna recommended it.
Nate agreed to tell Joanna what he thought of "Little Women" after watching it, and Joanna asked him to let her know his opinion.
Joanna invited Nate to contact her whenever he needed movie recommendations, and Nate said he would reach out when he ran out of things to watch.
Joanna and Nate ended their conversation by exchanging friendly goodbyes and wishing each other well.
On 2022-02-25, Nate made his friend chocolate-and-vanilla swirl ice cream, and Nate's friend loved it.
On 2022-02-25, Nate shared a photo showing a person holding a cone of chocolate-and-vanilla swirl ice cream.
Joanna cannot have dairy and therefore cannot eat regular dairy ice cream.
Joanna is keen to try sweet desserts and is always up for something sweet.
On 2022-02-25, Nate offered to send Joanna his dairy-free ice-cream recipe using coconut milk, and Joanna accepted and planned to try it.
Joanna loves Nate's dessert creations and considers Nate's cooking amazing.
On 2022-02-25, Joanna said she could not stop thinking about her first submitted screenplay while waiting to hear how it did, so she started writing another screenplay.

On 2022-02-25, Nate acknowledged that taking one's mind off waiting for screenplay results is challenging and asked Joanna what her new screenplay is about; the subject of the new screenplay had not yet been stated.

On February 25, 2022, Joanna said her second screenplay is about a thirty-year-old woman on a journey of self-discovery after a loss. The screenplay is somewhat similar to Joanna's first screenplay because this is the kind of subject Joanna is inspired to write about.

Joanna said the second screenplay is her own story, inspired by personal experiences and Joanna's own journey of self-discovery. Its main character deals with loss and struggles to understand her identity, then takes a road trip to heal and grow.
Nate described Joanna's second screenplay as a deep, awesome topic and said he likes stories that tackle important issues.
Joanna hopes her screenplay gets noticed and makes it to the screen, and she expressed uncertainty while waiting for its outcome with 'Fingers crossed.'

Nate encouraged Joanna about both her second screenplay and the results of her first screenplay, saying he was eager to see the second screenplay come together and hoped the first screenplay would find a fan and receive its due.

Nate and Joanna are the interlocutors. On 2022-02-25, Joanna said her second screenplay is a partly autobiographical road-trip story about a 30-year-old woman dealing with loss, identity, healing, and growth; it was inspired by Joanna's personal experiences and self-discovery and resembles her first screenplay. Joanna hopes her screenplay is noticed and reaches the screen. Nate praised the subject, said he likes stories about important issues, and supported both screenplays. Joanna cannot have dairy, likes sweet desserts, and accepted Nate's offer of a coconut-milk dairy-free ice-cream recipe.
On March 18, 2022, Joanna told Nate that she had finished writing her second screenplay after previously working on it while awaiting results from her first submitted screenplay.

Joanna described mixed emotions after finishing her second screenplay: relief, anxiety about what comes next, excitement, terror, hope, and doubt about whether her work will be noticed and reach the big screen.
On March 18, 2022, Joanna said she had been decompressing after completing her second screenplay but found it difficult to switch off because of an ongoing tug-of-war between hope and doubt.
Nate encouraged Joanna to believe in herself, saying that her hard work and passion would show through, her screenplay would be noticed, and things would work out.
On March 18, 2022, Nate shared a photograph of two tortoises lying on the ground in a jungle and said that walking them reminded him to enjoy the small stuff.
Nate keeps turtles as pets and is drawn to them because they are unique, move slowly, require relatively little maintenance, and create a calming contrast to the rush of life.
On March 18, 2022, Nate shared a photograph of three turtles sitting on rocks in a pond; Joanna thought the turtles looked peaceful.
Nate says caring for his turtles involves keeping their area clean, feeding them properly, and ensuring they receive enough light; he finds turtle care fun.
Nate believes pets bring substantial joy, provide companionship, are cute, and offer a relaxing way to unwind.
Joanna is allergic to turtles and recently discovered that she is also allergic to cockroaches; because of her allergies, Joanna is uncertain whether she will ever be able to have a pet.
Joanna wishes she could have pets and said she would get two turtles immediately if her allergies allowed it.
Nate offered to send Joanna photographs of his turtles so she can watch them grow without getting too close and risking an allergic reaction.
Joanna is already emotionally invested in Nate's turtles and wants to follow their growth through photographs.
Nate asked Joanna what ideas she has for the next steps with her screenplay now that she finished the second screenplay.
Joanna is conducting ongoing research and networking to advance her second screenplay and help it reach the big screen; she is determined to make it happen despite the difficulty.
Nate believes Joanna's research and networking should get more people to notice her screenplay and encourages her to keep working hard.
Joanna said that Nate's support means a lot to her and gives her motivation to keep pushing forward while she works on the screenplay; she hopes the next steps will become clearer soon.
Nate told Joanna not to quit, said the path forward would appear soon, and reassured Joanna that she could succeed. Nate said he is there for Joanna and is glad his support makes a difference.
On March 18, 2022, Joanna shared a photo showing a cinema ticket resting on a chair before saying goodbye to Nate. The photo contains no recorded ticket details.
On March 23, 2022, Joanna auditioned for a writing gig. The audition went alright, and Joanna felt excited but also somewhat anxious about it.
On March 24, 2022, Nate encouraged Joanna about the writing-gig audition, said he had faith in Joanna, and asked Joanna to keep him updated. Joanna said Nate's support meant a lot to her.
On March 24, 2022, Nate was participating in a video game tournament again. Nate described the tournament as intense, with a great deal of adrenaline.
Joanna described a bookshelf filled with books and magazines as her go-to place for writing inspiration. She said it helps her stay sharp and motivated, and she shared a photo showing the bookshelf.

Joanna advised Nate, who wants to pursue writing, to read extensively, try different genres, build a strong understanding of literature, write and share work without fear, practice, gather feedback, believe in himself, and continue pursuing his writing dreams despite the difficulty.
On March 24, 2022, Nate said he would keep working hard on writing and see what happens. Nate and Joanna encouraged each other to keep pursuing their dreams and working hard.
Nate and Joanna maintain a mutually supportive friendship focused partly on their creative and professional ambitions; they exchange encouragement, updates, and writing advice.
On 2022-04-08, Nate dyed his hair purple and shared a selfie photo showing himself wearing glasses with purple hair. Nate felt stoked, liberated, and excited about the change.
Nate chose a bright, bold purple hair color because he wanted to stand out from regular options and felt the color reflected his bold personality.

On 2022-04-15, Joanna shared a photo associated with a gorgeous sunset she saw while hiking; the image showed a street with a stop sign under a cloudy sky. Joanna said the experience made her realize the importance of showing the world who people are.
Joanna enjoyed the gorgeous sky during her recent hike but did not have a vacation planned because her writing was consuming her; she hoped to receive good news about her writing soon.

Joanna said Nate's support meant a lot to her and promised to keep him updated about how her writing was going. Nate encouraged Joanna to keep him posted because he understood that large projects could be taxing.
On 2022-04-15, Nate and Joanna ended their conversation warmly, saying they would see each other soon and exchanging goodbyes.
On April 17, 2022, Joanna told Nate that she had been reading many books during the previous week, including numerous good books she had forgotten she owned.
On April 17, 2022, Nate said he probably also had many books that he had not read in years and described revisiting them as a blast from the past.
On April 16, 2022, Joanna found an awesome, gorgeous hiking trail in her hometown and said nature inspires her and helps her reset.
Joanna enjoys nature deeply; walking through it, feeling it, and hearing its sounds are calming for her, and nature has always been her haven where worries and stress seem to vanish.
Nate is not particularly into hiking, but he likes nature and knows of a nice hiking trail just north of where he lives.
Joanna suggested convincing Nate to go hiking with her sometime, and Nate said he might go because he likes nature and thinks going with someone else could be fun.
Nate said spending time with his pets and engaging in his hobbies help him take a break from reality and appreciate life's small sources of happiness.
Joanna believes small things, such as spending time with pets and doing enjoyable activities, are treasures that make life peaceful and worth savoring.
On April 17, 2022, Nate shared a photo showing one of his turtles and a strawberry in a bowl; Joanna responded that the turtle was cute and said she loved Nate's turtles.
Nate said he enjoys watching his turtles play and sometimes brings them into the kitchen to watch him make food. He shared a photo showing a bowl of ice cream and a bowl of sprinkles.
Joanna said she loved Nate's ice cream and wished she could make it the way Nate does.
Nate said his ice cream is dairy-free and easy to make, and offered to give Joanna the recipe.
Joanna is lactose intolerant and needs dairy-free recipes.

Nate’s dairy-free ice cream recipe uses coconut milk, vanilla extract, sugar, and a pinch of salt; the mixture is chilled in the refrigerator, then put in an ice cream maker and frozen until scoopable.
Joanna planned to make Nate’s coconut-milk dairy-free ice cream recipe on the evening of April 17, 2022, and promised to tell Nate how it turned out.
Joanna thought Nate’s coconut-milk dairy-free ice cream recipe sounded delicious and thanked Nate for sharing it.
On 2022-04-21, Joanna told Nate that she had joined a writers group with inspirational, supportive people who understood her writing; Joanna felt motivated and that she finally belonged somewhere.
On 2022-04-21, Joanna shared a photo showing a notebook, a notepad, and a piece of paper.
On 2022-04-21, Nate encouraged Joanna about her supportive writers group and asked what projects Joanna was working on with the group.
On 2022-04-21, Nate shared a photo of a cup of ice cream topped with a cherry.

On 2022-04-21, Joanna said that her writers group had made great progress on a project titled "Finding Home," a script about a girl journeying to find her true home. Joanna described the project as rewarding and emotional.
On 2022-04-21, Joanna asked Nate whether he had any upcoming gaming tournaments.
Nate said that he had a gaming tournament planned for May 2022 and that it would be his fourth gaming tournament. Nate felt good about participating.
On April 21, 2022, Joanna recalled that during her first play she became so nervous that she forgot her lines. The embarrassing experience taught Joanna to prepare well and stay in the moment.
On April 21, 2022, Joanna shared a photo showing Joanna in a striped suit performing on stage.
Joanna said acting was her first passion, but writing now lets Joanna express herself in a new way and is where Joanna really shines. Joanna may return to acting someday.
Nate encouraged Joanna to follow her passion for writing and to try acting again if acting makes Joanna happy.
Joanna particularly enjoys dramas and emotionally driven films, which may inspire Joanna's writing.
On April 21, 2022, Nate shared a photo showing a turtle lying on a bed of rocks and gravel.
Nate loves fantasy and science-fiction movies because they provide an escape and stimulate Nate's imagination.
Nate considers playing video games a way to express Nate's creativity and passion.
On April 21, 2022, Nate shared a photo showing a black Xbox controller sitting on top of a wooden table.
On April 21, 2022, Joanna asked Nate whether Nate had a favorite fantasy or science-fiction movie; no answer was provided in this segment.
Nate considers an unspecified trilogy one of his favorite trilogies because its world-building, battles, and storytelling impress him.
Nate shared a photo of a shelf containing many books.
Nate recommends an unspecified book series featuring adventures, magic, and great characters.
Nate shared a photo of several books arranged on a table.
Joanna is interested in receiving new book recommendations and is open to reading Nate's recommended series.
Joanna plans to check out Nate's recommended series and tell Nate her thoughts after reading it.
Joanna and Nate ended their conversation cordially, wishing each other a great day.
On May 1, 2022, Joanna watched Nate's recommended The Lord of the Rings trilogy and thought it was awesome. Joanna shared a photo of a person holding an open book.
Nate considers The Lord of the Rings trilogy probably the greatest trilogy of all time.
On May 2, 2022, Nate had a gaming room with a computer and gaming chair and was spending much of his time gaming.
During the week before May 2, 2022, Nate won his second gaming tournament. Nate shared a photo showing a woman with purple hair wearing a black dress.

Nate usually plays Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS:GO). For his second tournament win, Nate entered a local Street Fighter tournament because he often plays Street Fighter with his friends, and Nate discovered he was very good at it.

Nate felt super awesome and highly energized after winning the final match of his second gaming tournament; Nate said a lot of adrenaline went into the last match, and the other finalist shook Nate's hand.
Joanna is proud of Nate's gaming achievements and congratulated Nate on winning the tournament.
On May 2, 2022, Joanna shared a photo of a homemade cake with white frosting on a wooden table. The cake was dairy-free vanilla with strawberry filling and coconut cream frosting.

Joanna enjoys experimenting in the kitchen and considers cooking and baking her creative outlets. She finds it rewarding to create delicious dairy-free desserts and see friends and family smile while eating them.
Joanna has been working on her screenplay and other projects while testing dairy-free dessert recipes for friends and family.
Joanna liked Nate's earlier recommendation to use coconut in dairy-free desserts.
Nate complimented Joanna's cake, praised her talent for making dairy-free desserts, and encouraged her to keep creating new recipes.
Nate said goodbye to Joanna at 11:54 AM on May 2, 2022, ending the conversation.
On May 12, 2022, Joanna went hiking on newly discovered trails in her town and described the experience as awesome, joking that she had become an expert hiker.
On May 12, 2022, Joanna photographed a waterfall at Whispering Falls, showing rushing water, green scenery, and a dark sky in the background.

Joanna found Whispering Falls beautiful, peaceful, and serene; the sound of the rushing water and the surrounding natural beauty made Joanna feel calm and peaceful, focused on the present while everything else faded away.
Joanna finds nature calming and inspiring. Hiking has made Joanna feel like a different person and opened up a new world for her.
Joanna often feels able to write an entire movie when visiting remarkable natural places, and the trails at Whispering Falls specifically inspired Joanna to write a drama.
When Nate spends time in nature, Nate tends to think deeply about life or new recipes rather than feeling drawn to hiking itself.
Nate expressed happiness about Joanna's hiking experience and wished he could have visited the trails with Joanna.
Nate plans to join Joanna on the hiking trails sometime, and Joanna invited Nate to hike with her.
Nate is considering writing a drama and publishing his own screenplay.
Joanna reacted enthusiastically and humorously to Nate's idea of writing and publishing a drama screenplay.
Nate and Joanna ended their conversation by saying goodbye to each other after discussing hiking together and Nate's screenplay idea.
On May 20, 2022, Nate told Joanna that he had adopted a dog named Max and shared a photo of Max lying on a couch in a living room.
Max is an energetic adopted dog who brings Nate a great deal of joy and keeps Nate's other pets active.
Nate has pets besides Max.
Nate believes pets make people much happier and never let people down.
Joanna said that pets make life better and expressed happiness that Max brings Nate joy.
On May 20, 2022, Joanna said she had just finished something that she described as a wild journey; the nature of the completed work or activity was not specified.
On May 20, 2022, Nate asked Joanna whether she had thought more about getting a pet of her own; Joanna's answer was not provided.
Joanna has allergies that discourage her from getting pets, and she has not researched alternative pets because she considers herself too lazy to do so.
Joanna finds comfort during tough times through writing and creative projects, and she is grateful for her supportive friends.
Joanna values friends who understand and appreciate her writing, discuss it with her, and provide feedback.
On 2022-05-20, Joanna shared a photo of a notepad with a dog on it and a pen, showing a writing project she had completed after a difficult journey.
The project shown by Joanna on 2022-05-20 was her third writing project or story.
Joanna's third writing project is personal and explores loss, identity, and connection; it was a story she had carried for ages before finding the courage to write it.
Joanna believes meaningful stories come from personal experiences and feelings, and she writes best when she is true to herself, even when doing so is difficult or frightening.
Joanna likes writing about sadness and loss and is willing to be vulnerable and explore difficult personal experiences in her work.
Joanna felt proud of completing her personal writing project despite the difficulty and fear involved in writing it.
Joanna told Nate that his support and encouragement make her writing journey easier, and Nate expressed pride in her, praised her talent and potential, and encouraged her to pursue her dreams.
On 2022-05-23, Nate took his dog Max for a walk, met a very nice nearby couple who also had a dog, and arranged doggy playdates with them so the pets could socialize.
Max enjoys playing with the nearby couple’s dog, and Nate believes having a walking and playdate buddy will be great for Max.
Nate thinks that sharing a love of animals is enough common ground to become good friends, even when people have little else in common.
Nate feels immense happiness watching Max play with the other dog and describes seeing Max so happy as a dream come true.
Joanna views connecting with other pet owners as uplifting and rewarding and encouraged Nate to continue meeting people through his pets.
On 2022-05-25, Nate shared a photo with Joanna showing a stuffed animal lying on a bed and presented it as a new stuffed “pup” for Joanna to remind her of good vibes.
On 2022-05-25, Nate said the stuffed animal brings him joy, feels like having joy in his pocket, and makes him grin whenever he looks at it.
Joanna values small joys, cherishes sentimental reminders, and believes remembering happy moments makes life feel better and helps people through difficult times.
Nate believes that appreciating little moments and enjoying the journey makes difficult times worthwhile and helps prevent feeling down.
Joanna said that remembering the difficult times involved in finishing her screenplay helped her realize that joyful moments make the creative journey worthwhile.
Joanna plans to show her completed screenplay to Nate, values his opinion, and will keep him updated; Nate enthusiastically promised to support her and said he looks forward to seeing it.

Nate and Joanna exchanged warm encouragement about finding happiness in small things and pursuing Joanna’s screenplay, with Joanna expressing appreciation for Nate’s support and Nate reassuring Joanna that she can succeed.
On 2022-06-03, Joanna told Nate that after finishing her screenplay she received a rejection letter from a major company, which upset and discouraged her.
On 2022-06-03, Joanna said the company sent only a generic rejection letter with little feedback, leaving her disheartened because she did not know why the screenplay was rejected.

On 2022-06-03, Nate encouraged Joanna not to interpret the rejection as evidence that she lacks talent, urged her to keep pursuing her dreams, and offered continued support. Joanna appreciated Nate's kindness and said she would not let the rejection bring her down.

Around 2022-05-27, Nate won another regional video game tournament. He said the victory was exciting, introduced him to new people, gave him a major confidence boost, and made him feel that his hard work had paid off.
Nate enjoys connecting with fellow gamers and has participated in video game tournaments for years; Joanna regularly hears about his tournaments and supports his progress.

After Nate's regional video game tournament in late May 2022, Nate spoke with several male tournament attendees who invited him to hang out later. Nate agreed to help them improve their game by giving them tips, because he likes helping people.
On 2022-06-03, Nate shared a photo showing a purple-and-blue video game controller decorated with a star-field design.
Joanna planned to hike with friends during the weekend of 2022-06-04 to 2022-06-05, exploring a new trail featuring a waterfall. Joanna was excited about the outing.

Nate planned to organize a gaming party during the weekend of 2022-06-17 to 2022-06-19. He expected the party to be hectic but fun and intended to invite his recent tournament friends, older friends, and teammates from other tournaments.
For Nate's gaming party planned for 2022-06-17 to 2022-06-19, Nate intended to give every attendee custom controller decorations as a special party favor.
Joanna thought Nate's idea of making custom decorations for the gaming party was sweet and believed the party guests would love it.
Joanna planned to take photos during her waterfall hike with friends on June 4–5, 2022, after Nate encouraged her to take lots of pictures.
Joanna and Nate ended their conversation amicably on June 3, 2022, saying goodbye and planning to speak later.

On June 4, 2022, Joanna saw a few screenplay passages she had written appear on the big screen. The experience was nerve-wracking but inspiring, and seeing her hard work come alive felt like a roller coaster that ultimately paid off.
On June 5, 2022, Joanna shared a photo of a Spider-Man poster hanging on a wall.

Joanna has always considered Spider-Man one of her favorite superheroes because she relates to Peter Parker’s struggle to balance being a hero with being a person. Joanna is generally fond of superheroes and their distinct stories and powers.
Nate’s favorite superhero is Iron Man. Nate likes Iron Man’s technology and sarcastic humor, and superhero figures make Nate feel invincible.
On June 5, 2022, Nate shared a photo of a toy Iron Man figure standing on a white surface.
Nate got the Iron Man figure because it reminded him of something he loves, and keeping it in his room reminds him to continue working toward his goals.
Joanna keeps a cork board as a personal corner of inspiration; it contains motivational quotes, photos, and small keepsakes that support her creativity and motivation.
On June 5, 2022, Joanna shared a photo of a picture frame containing a family photograph on her cork board.
The family photograph on Joanna’s cork board reminds Joanna daily of her family’s love and encouragement, which means a lot to her and keeps her going.
On June 5, 2022, Nate said he should start a cork board of his own because he viewed Joanna’s cork board as valuable and inspiring.
On June 5, 2022, Joanna said she would definitely recommend the previously discussed activity or item, provided the person was willing to explain it to their friends.
On June 5, 2022, Nate said he was willing to explain the previously discussed activity or item to his friends.
On June 5, 2022, Nate and Joanna ended their conversation by saying goodbye to each other.
On June 24, 2022, Joanna submitted her recent screenplay to a film contest to find out how other people might like it.
On June 24, 2022, Nate said his gaming party was a great success, and that he and his friends played Chess afterward for fun.
On June 24, 2022, Joanna asked Nate whether his friends liked the controller accessories used or shared at the gaming party; Nate had not answered yet in this segment.
Nate reported that most of the attendees at his gaming party liked the controller accessories, although he did not know whether all of them would continue using the accessories.
Nate said that 7 people attended his gaming party, and 6 attendees said they would like to hold another gaming gathering the following month.
Nate and Joanna agreed that the thought behind giving the controller accessories mattered more than whether the recipients continued to use them.
On 2022-06-17, Nate made vegan ice cream and shared it with people in his vegan diet group; Nate said the ice cream was awesome. Nate shared a photo showing a group of people sitting on a bench.
Joanna expressed interest in Nate's vegan ice cream and asked Nate for the recipe because she thought it sounded good.
Nate agreed to give Joanna the vegan ice cream recipe on 2022-06-25.
Joanna planned to make Nate's vegan ice cream recipe for her family during the weekend of 2022-06-25 to 2022-06-26.
Joanna said that Joanna's family loves it when Joanna makes them new foods.
Nate believed Joanna's family would love the vegan ice cream.
Joanna promised to update Nate about how Joanna's family liked the vegan ice cream, and Nate looked forward to hearing about the result.

Nate and Joanna are the interlocutors. On 2022-06-24, Joanna submitted her recent screenplay to a film contest to gauge reactions and congratulated Nate on his successful gaming party. Nate's party had 7 attendees; most liked the controller accessories, six wanted another gathering the following month, and attendees played Chess afterward. Nate made vegan ice cream on 2022-06-17, shared it with his vegan diet group, and showed Joanna a photo of people sitting on a bench. Joanna requested the recipe, Nate promised it for 2022-06-25, and Joanna planned to make it for her family on the 2022-06-25..2022-06-26 weekend and report back.

On 2022-07-08, Nate won his fourth video game tournament, which was held online. Nate described the competition and victory as awesome and indescribable, felt proud of making money through gaming, and shared a photo showing a television screen with a trophy and a separate trophy.

Around 2022-07-08 to 2022-07-10, Joanna took a research road trip for her next movie to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest. Joanna viewed the trip as a much-needed break and an opportunity to explore new places and find inspiration.
Woodhaven had lovely scenery, historic buildings, and a library with a notable old book collection. Joanna shared a photo of a bookshelf filled with many books.

At the Woodhaven library, Joanna found a book from the 1900s containing stories and sketches about the town and the people who lived there. She shared a photo of the book, showing writing on its pages and a pen.
Learning about Woodhaven's interesting past, its many notable people, and how the town changed over time sparked ideas for Joanna's next script.
Joanna said her new script would be different from her previous work and had the potential to be something awesome. Joanna was excited about the project and planned to keep Nate updated.

Nate consistently encouraged Joanna's writing, expressed confidence in her talent, and told Joanna that he was always there to support her. Joanna said Nate's encouragement and support meant a lot to her and called him the best supporter of her writing journey.
After Joanna's movie performed well, Joanna recently began writing a book. She shared a photo of a person holding a notebook open to a handwritten page.
Nate asked Joanna what her new book was about, beginning a discussion about the book's subject.
On July 10, 2022, Joanna said a page of her new book explores loss, redemption, and forgiveness through emotionally deep dialogue, and she is excited about the story.
On July 10, 2022, Joanna said she had never tried publishing a book before and might make this story her first published book.
On July 10, 2022, Nate encouraged Joanna, saying readers would recognize her as the author of her successfully published movie and might love her book even more.
On July 10, 2022, Joanna said Nate's belief in her meant a lot, and Nate promised to support her, encouraged her to believe in her talent, and told her that her hard work would pay off.
